newsitem.title: USA: LPC-Bankers Trust lending Collins & Aikman $85 mln.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Bankers Trust lending Collins & Aikman $85 mln.

text.p: NEW YORK, Jan 20 (LPC) - Bankers Trust New York Corp on January 15 began syndicating its fully underwritten, $85 million credit for Quad-C and Paribas Principal Partners's roughly $197 million acquisition of Collins & Aikman Floorcoverings, market sources said.
BT Securities also is leading a $100 million, 144A, senior subordinated note offering for the acquisition, bankers said.
The five-year loan is split between a $30 million revolver and a $55 million term loan, with pricing set at 250 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate, sources said.
